newsitem.title: USA: Falcon Building Q1 net rises on sales gains.
newsitem.headline: Falcon Building Q1 net rises on sales gains.

text.p: Falcon Building Products Corp said Thursday revenue gains helped fuel a 13-percent increase in earnings in the first quarter ended March 31.
The company, which provides building products for a variety of markets, said net income reached $6.1 million, or $0.31 a share, versus $5.4 million, or $0.27, a year ago.
Total revenues climbed to $160.2 million from $144.4 million thanks to growth in the company's core business and not through acquisitions, Falcon Building said.
The company said it signed a merger agreement during the quarter with an affiliate of Investcorp SA. A special meeting of shareholders will be held soon to vote on the proposal, teh company said.
Falcon Building shares closed fell 1/8 Thursday at 17-1/4.
